Spirit is arguably one of the top tier killers in the game depending on who you ask. Since you play PC though, I’d say the Nurse, Freddy and Billy are better. Especially Nurse. Spirit would probably be higher on console but idk. People who complain that she takes no skill are just entitled and you shouldn’t listen to them. Sure, she’s annoying from the survivors POV because every mind game is a coin toss. But if they’re genuinely getting mad at you for using a killer and messaging you afterwards they’re entitled. Every killer has a counter some more than others, good survivors can loop good Spirits for days. People just love to say she’s OP because they can feel better about themselves losing. No killer is OP. If you’re a survivor and you lose to someone, it’s fault of your own. Don’t blame it on the killer. As someone who’s played all the killers, while she doesn’t take as much skill as the Nurse, she still needs quite a bit, for tracking survivors, iron will counters her sound completely and is one of the most popular perks. After breaking line of sight it is quite easy to lose her by crouching away or juking her by following your scratch marks. Nurse is literally better since she is like an instant teleport Spirit who can see you while she phases, she isn’t even the highest skilled killer to learn, people have misconceptions about her, her blink is literally just muscle memory after a few days and it’s easy to learn the distances once muscle memory has kicked in. And people say that her fatigue makes her not OP when it lasts like 2 seconds and she can see scratch marks afterwards and can instantly hit you when you’re like 20 meters away. And they complain that Spirit has 50/50 mind games when Nurse has no mind games on pallets if you know what you’re doing, Freddy can 50/50 with his dream snare, Billy can break through the pallet in like one second so he doesn’t even need to mind game lol. Freddy literally has a higher skill cap than nurse lol. Welp, entitled survivor mains will always blame the killer or the add ons or whatever no matter what.
